summary: The approximate-rank depth criterion and the full-true-rank example are proved without mathematical errors or gaps. Small dimensions, zero approximation error, maximal allowed error, rank-zero approximants, coincident atoms, zero-volume fibers, and degenerate halfspace normals produce no counterexample. The supplied predecessor facts are used with their original actual-fiber centroids and actual-volume probabilities; the stronger coordinate-sign hypothesis is not imported into the present symmetry argument. Prékopa Theorem 8 and Bobkov-Ledoux Proposition B.2, equation (B.7), were checked in the cited primary PDFs and apply exactly to the positive-variance conditional projections. The single convex-hull lift is fixed before all halfspaces, the shifted-cap loss is at most 2 epsilon, and simultaneous base negation supplies the factor one half. The constructed ball fibers satisfy the covariance and residual bounds, have exactly the asserted positive integer bases, and have true affine centroid rank d with approximation rank zero.
